seed_injection.note: The installed bridge injects these seeds. Verified on 2026-10-07 by a real fixed-mode embark on the acceptance track: the POST echoed seed_requested and seed_canonical equal to the registered value, named NCharacterSelectScreen.BeginRun as the injection path, and the authoritative compendium.current_run.seed read back the same value — which is the rule docs/FIXED_SEED_FEASIBILITY.md set. The bridge's own seed_verified stays false by design, so the read-back, not the response, is the verification; the run-identity guard fails closed on any mismatch, which is why a batch that produced a run_identity is itself the test. This says nothing about whether two runs on one seed agree — reproducibility of outcomes is a separate measurement.
seed_injection.verified_by: scripts/capture_seeded_embark_evidence.py — requested/canonical/read-back all equal "1600000000" on one real embark; the bridge itself reports seed_verified=false and never attests
